title: Oncall Summaries v2 — condensed causal graph + runbook merge
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Build Oncall Summaries v2 — a compact, actionable incident summary that (1) derives a condensed causal graph from traces/metrics/logs, (2) merges and prioritizes steps from matching runbooks, and (3) surfaces scored remediation suggestions and one-click rollback/mitigation actions in Slack and PagerDuty payloads.

Why: Current incident cards are verbose and siloed: traces, logs, and runbooks live in separate views and engineers spend the first 10–20 minutes stitching context. A single compact summary with an inferred causal path and the highest-confidence runbook snippets will reduce time-to-action and improve first-touch resolution rates.

Scope/Features: 
- Trace ingestion hooks: sample and attach representative span snippets and causal edges (caller->callee latency correlations).
- Metrics/log correlation: attach an anomaly timeline aligned with the causal graph nodes.
- Runbook merge: find top-3 matching runbooks by hint-matching and signal similarity, extract the minimal actionable snippet (preflight checks + mitigation steps) and de-duplicate overlapping steps.
- Scoring and confidence bands: assign a remediation score (0–100) and confidence tag (low/medium/high) based on signal coverage and historical success rate.
- Action buttons: Slack quick-actions (run diagnostic script, toggle circuit breaker, postmortem stub creation) and PagerDuty enriched payload that can include a one-click rollback link to the deployment system when available.
- Postmortem automation: auto-create a postmortem draft with the causal graph, chosen runbook snippets, and key metrics slices; attach to the incident with links to PRs/commits when present.

Design decisions and trade-offs: 
- Representing causality: we will infer edges using latency cross-correlation and p99 propagations rather than attempting to compute formal causality; this keeps compute light but may miss deep causal chains. Acceptable trade-off because goal is signal-first triage assistance.
- Sampling level: default to a 1% tail-favoring sampler for traces, with on-demand deep-dump when user clicks to expand. Keeps payload sizes small for Slack/PagerDuty.
- Runbook merging heuristics: prioritize steps that are idempotent and safe to surface; redact any steps that require admin creds. This reduces risk but may omit privileged remediation.
- Telemetry load: initial rollout will limit enriched payloads to incidents whose p95 latency breach > threshold to control cost.

Dependencies: 
- Tracing hooks and enriched span extraction (ENG-412312).
- Metrics log pipeline filter for anomaly timeline slices (ENG-237001, infra team).
- Slack action button framework and PagerDuty extended payload schema (ENG-73145, ENG-110127).
- Runbook canonicalization work for snippet extraction (PM-1421).

Rollout plan: 
- Week 1 (prototype): Build causal-graph generator and simple runbook matcher; surface summary in a dev-only Slack channel. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/847
- Week 2 (pilot): Enable for internal production incidents with a single service owning the experiment; collect qualitative feedback from oncall rotation.
- Week 3 (broader beta): Add scoring, action buttons, and postmortem draft automation; expose opt-in in console per-team.
- Week 4 (GA): Default opt-in for accounts on internal tiers and monitor key metrics.

Success metrics: 
- Reduction in mean time to first mitigation (MTFM) by 25% for pilot services.
- Fraction of incidents where oncall used suggested runbook snippet >= 40%.
- False-positive/incorrect-action rate below 5% for surfaced remediation suggestions.

Security and privacy notes: redact any tokens/credentials from runbook snippets. Ensure action buttons that trigger remediation require SSO-confirmed auth and audit trail.

Open questions: 
- How do we represent multi-service causal graphs in a single compact UI without overwhelming the card? (UX input required)
- What SLAs should we expose for the enrichment pipeline latency?

Links and artifacts: 
- Proto spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Oncall+Summaries+v2
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/847
- Dashboard for pilot metrics: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/incident-summaries/pilot
